units: metres, kilograms, seconds; axes are glTF (Y up, -Z is rover left, +X forward)
source: hardware/sim/export_sim.py from hardware/assembly/rover.py and hardware/mass/replica.py; docs/sim-spec.md

joints.name: wheelFL
joints.note: axis is rover +Y (glTF (0,0,-1)); the rover rolls forward for a positive rotation about it with the right-hand rule

joints.name: wheelFR
joints.note: axis is rover +Y (glTF (0,0,-1)); the rover rolls forward for a positive rotation about it with the right-hand rule

joints.name: wheelRL
joints.note: axis is rover +Y (glTF (0,0,-1)); the rover rolls forward for a positive rotation about it with the right-hand rule

joints.name: wheelRR
joints.note: axis is rover +Y (glTF (0,0,-1)); the rover rolls forward for a positive rotation about it with the right-hand rule

tilt.note: swept clear to 90 either way in the CAD; the original tilts +-75 [S19]

camera.sensor: Raspberry Pi HQ (IMX477) with a 4 mm CS lens
camera.note: FOV from a 6.287 x 4.712 mm active area (Raspberry Pi camera documentation, checked 2026-11-09) and 4 mm focal length, no distortion

ground_reference: y = 0 is the rim line (grouser tips reach 12.2 mm below it)
